title: Rotten Beregost Blue Wedge
summary: Eating it gives Poisoned for 10 turns.

fields.Consume: Single use. Gain Poisoned for 10 turns. This gives disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
fields.Durability: 1 HP. Resists Piercing, is vulnerable to Bludgeoning, and is immune to Poison and Psychic.
